╭────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ enter         send                                 │
│ \ enter       newline (also alt+enter)             │
│ ↑ ↓           history (on the first / last line)   │
│ /             commands                             │
│ @path         complete a file in the world (tab)   │
│ esc           interrupt the turn · clear the input │
│ ctrl+c ×2     exit                                 │
│ ctrl+o        expand the last collapsed block      │
│ ctrl+l        redraw                               │
│ ?             this list                            │
╰────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
